Cosmic Clash

Build a 20-card deck from the cards you've collected, then battle a bot or another player online. Knock the enemy Core from 20 Life to 0. Wins and challenges earn Stardust.

How to play
A guided practice battle. No rewards, and it doesn't count in your record.
  1. Energy: you start with 1 Energy and gain 1 more each turn, up to 10. It refills every turn. Each card costs the Energy in its blue gem.
  2. Turns: draw a card, play cards, attack, then press End turn. Players start with 4 cards and the second player gets a 5th.
  3. Units go into your 5 board slots. Power is orange, Health is red. Units can attack once per turn, starting the turn after they arrive.
  4. Attacking: tap a glowing unit, then an enemy unit or the enemy Core. Units hit each other at the same time. Damage to a unit stays.
  5. Events have a one-time effect, then go to the discard pile.
  6. Limits: hand size is 8, and extra draws are burned. With an empty deck you take growing damage instead of drawing.
  7. Traps go face-down into your 2 trap slots. They spring on their own during your opponent’s turn: when an enemy attacks, lands a unit, attacks your Core or casts an event, depending on the trap.
  8. Set bonuses: control 3 or more units from one series to switch on its bonus. Cosmic Alignment: your Cosmos units +1 Power. Constellation: draw 2 cards when it switches on. Mission Control: +1 Energy and an extra card each turn, and Upgrades give +2/+2. Planetfall: restore 2 Life to your Core each turn.
  9. Placement matters: Gravity boosts the units next to it, and Link units buff themselves and their neighbours when they arrive.
  10. ✦ Shiny cards play exactly like the regular card. The shine is just for show.
  11. Win by bringing the enemy Core to 0 Life.
